name: screenshots
title: Screenshots
description: Browse screenshots in a directory as a grid, paste them into the active app or copy them to the clipboard. The floating full-size preview requires Hyprland and imv.
author: prdlk

commands.name: search-screenshots
commands.title: Search Screenshots
commands.description: Search, preview, paste or copy screenshots from your screenshots directory

preferences.name: screenshotsDirectory
preferences.title: Screenshots Directory
preferences.description: Directory to search for PNG, JPEG and WebP screenshots. A leading ~ is expanded to your home directory.

preferences.name: columns
preferences.title: Grid Columns
preferences.description: Screenshots per row. Fewer columns give larger previews.
